weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg1:start to seg1:end a horizontal bar chart titled 'HIGHEST IN 2023' has five completely empty tracks (no fill on any bar), so the scene is only the values -8, -6.5, -5, -3.5 and -2.3 printed on the right. Data floats between rows and covers the 2010 track.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The bars encode negative temperatures from a zero baseline, so every bar length comes out as nothing or invisible. The scene also repeats seg0's warming series as a chart instead of showing ground thawing. The mascot has no anchor on a moving part.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace it with a bespoke frozen-ground cross-section: a column of permafrost whose ice line visibly retreats and whose thermometer rises from -8 to -2.3 °C as the years tick 1983 to 2023. Data drives the warming by turning a heat dial or chipping the ice, with his hands on the moving part. Drop the empty bar chart entirely.
